scope: Actual TypeScript runtime transpiled in an isolated VM with the Vite import.meta.glob boundary supplied by test dictionaries. No DOM mutation, browser, network, build, source-component change or deployment.
checks: PT source preserves text and whitespace
Lazy dictionary loaded once; padding and interpolation preserved
Display data localized without mutation; logic keys, slugs, names and contracts stay exact
Missing display message reported to QA; technical values are not false misses
Disabled and missing dictionaries reject instead of activating a fake localized route
Late dictionary response cannot override a newer language selection
Build metadata translates explicitly without changing the active browser locale
